title: core.text.comments — the comments of a document
description: Who wrote each comment and when. A comment's text is a story (a `core.text.blocks` node of kind `comment`); the text it is about lies between the `commentStart` and `commentEnd` objects carrying its id. spec/PROFILE-RICH-DOCUMENT.md section 3.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload schema: the constant 1.

comments.description: The comments, in ascending order of `id`.

items.description: The facts about one comment. Its text is a story.

id.description: The comment's number: what `commentStart` / `commentEnd` objects and a reply's `parent` refer to. Unique.

date.description: When the comment was written, ISO 8601; may be empty.

parent.description: For a reply: the `id` of the comment it replies to. Null: a top-level comment.

resolved.description: true: the comment is marked as resolved (done).

part.description: The comment's text: the `story.id` of a `core.text.blocks` node listed in the document node's `stories`, of kind `comment`.
